description.text:
The runner-up deck of the Masters Division at the 2016 World Championships. Talonflame's Gale Wings Ability let it start game after game as the Active Pokémon, buying time for a deck that is slow to get going, since Greninja BREAK takes several evolutions; once in play, its Giant Water Shuriken Ability hands out Knock Outs. The 2016 World Championships were held at the San Francisco Marriott Marquis in San Francisco, California, from 19 to 21 August 2016.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2016 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
